annotations.title: Pull a form's schema, theme, and draft

description: Read one form as the dashboard sees it: schema, theme, settings, status, and — unlike the public fillo_get_form — its UNPUBLISHED staged draft. Use this before editing an existing form so an edit is built on what is actually there. Needs a login token (FILLO_TOKEN) or a project API key with forms:read; reading the draft also needs forms:write on a key.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

includeDraft.description: Include the staged draft schema and theme (default true).

name: fillo_pull_form
